title: Tensor preserves finite stalk generation
statement: For commutative Λ and finite sheaves F,G of Λ-modules, F ⊗ G is finite.

proof.text: At each geometric stalk use the tensor stalk isomorphism and finite generation of tensor products of finitely generated modules.

lean.statement: theorem IsFiniteSheaf.tensorObj_part (hF : IsFiniteSheaf F) (hG : IsFiniteSheaf G) : IsFiniteSheaf (F ⊗ G)
